annotations.title: Add a channel to a tab

description: Adds a channel to a tab. 40 channels at most per tab. The response tells the folder and the tab where the channel went, so the screen opens in the right place. The response has the whole updated library, so you do not need to reload `GET /api/library`.

channel_id.description: Channel ID in the catalog, for example `GloboNews.br`.
